import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv', 
                   index_col=False, 
                   encoding='latin-1', 
                   sep=';')

# Convert date column to datetime
data['StichtagDat'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Create a bar chart of the top 10 most common breeds
top_10_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_10_breeds.index, y=top_10_breeds.values, 
            label='Top 10 Breeds')

plt.xlabel('Breed')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.title('Distribution of Dog Ages')

import pandas as pd

                   index_col=False, 
                   encoding='latin-1', 
                   sep=';')

            label='Top 10 Breeds')

plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.legend()

# Create a histogram of dog ages

plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
